name: Terraform / OpenTofu tools
description: Pinned Terraform/OpenTofu CLI plus tflint, terraform-docs, terraform-ls, trivy, pre-commit. Sole owner of these version pins; per-project configs override options instead of forking an image. No cloud CLIs — see cloud-tools.

flavor.description: Engine CLI: hashicorp/terraform or opentofu/tofu. Selects exactly one; never read from an ambient env var.

version.description: Engine version (interpret per flavor; the default is a Terraform pin). 'none' skips the engine.

pre-commit.description: pre-commit version (installed in its own venv, PEP 668); 'none' skips.
